_comment: AegisCampus IDS & Red-Team Attack Simulation Rules Dictionary. Catalogs detection thresholds, signatures, scan profiles, and attack vectors.

SYN_STEALTH.name: TCP SYN Stealth Scan
SYN_STEALTH.description: Half-open scanning technique sending raw SYN packets without completing the 3-way handshake.
SYN_STEALTH.pattern: Rapid TCP SYN packets across multiple ports within short time window without ACK

TCP_CONNECT.name: TCP Full Connect Scan
TCP_CONNECT.description: Establishes full 3-way TCP connections (SYN, SYN/ACK, ACK) then closes via RST or FIN.
TCP_CONNECT.pattern: Sequential standard socket connect attempts across port range

FIN_SCAN.name: TCP FIN Stealth Scan
FIN_SCAN.description: Sends packets with only the FIN flag set to bypass stateless packet filters and firewalls.
FIN_SCAN.pattern: Inbound TCP packets bearing FIN flag without prior established session state

XMAS_SCAN.name: TCP Xmas Tree Scan
XMAS_SCAN.description: Packets lit up like a Christmas tree with FIN, PSH, and URG flags set simultaneously.
XMAS_SCAN.pattern: RFC 793 violation with FIN+PSH+URG set on TCP header

NULL_SCAN.name: TCP NULL Scan
NULL_SCAN.description: Sends packets with zero TCP control flags set to probe for non-compliant RFC 793 stacks.
NULL_SCAN.pattern: TCP packet with all flag bits set to 0

ACK_SCAN.name: TCP ACK Firewall Mapping Scan
ACK_SCAN.description: Maps firewall rule sets and determines whether ports are filtered or unfiltered.
ACK_SCAN.pattern: Unsolicited ACK packets without established connection state

UDP_SCAN.name: UDP Port Sweep
UDP_SCAN.description: Sends 0-byte UDP packets to target ports; ICMP Port Unreachable indicates closed port.
UDP_SCAN.pattern: Burst of UDP datagrams to disparate high-order or service UDP ports

PING_SWEEP.name: ICMP Host Discovery / Ping Sweep
PING_SWEEP.description: Determines active hosts on network segment using ICMP Echo Requests.
PING_SWEEP.pattern: High rate of ICMP type 8 (Echo Request) packets across CIDR block

OS_DETECT.name: Remote OS Fingerprinting
OS_DETECT.description: Analyzes TCP/IP stack implementation nuances (window size, options, TTL, ISN sampling).
OS_DETECT.pattern: Unusual probe sequence of varied flag combinations and bogus TCP options

VERSION_DETECT.name: Service Version Probing (-sV)
VERSION_DETECT.description: Sends application-layer probe payloads to grab service banners and daemon versions.
VERSION_DETECT.pattern: Banner grabbing strings sent across open listening TCP ports

AGGRESSIVE_SCAN.name: Comprehensive Aggressive Scan (-A)
AGGRESSIVE_SCAN.description: Combined aggressive audit: OS detection (-O), service version (-sV), default scripts (-sC), and traceroute.
AGGRESSIVE_SCAN.pattern: Simultaneous port sweep, banner probe, OS fingerprinting, and NSE script executions

VULN_SCAN.name: Nmap NSE Vulnerability Audit
VULN_SCAN.description: Executes extensive Nmap Scripting Engine (NSE) vulnerability checks targeting known CVEs.
VULN_SCAN.pattern: Exploit signature strings and query probes targeting HTTP, SMB, SSL, and DB endpoints

FAST_PORT_SCAN.name: Fast Top-100 Port Scan (-F)
FAST_PORT_SCAN.description: Rapid triage scan checking the top 100 most commonly open ports.
FAST_PORT_SCAN.pattern: Targeted sweep across Nmap top 100 ports list

FULL_PORT_SCAN.name: All 65,535 Ports Sweep (-p-)
FULL_PORT_SCAN.description: Exhaustive port scan covering the entire range of 1 to 65535 TCP ports.
FULL_PORT_SCAN.pattern: Sequential or randomized sweeps covering high-order ephemeral ports > 1024

SMB_ETERNALBLUE_PROBE.name: SMB / EternalBlue Vulnerability Probe
SMB_ETERNALBLUE_PROBE.description: Probes SMBv1 protocol handlers for CVE-2017-0144 (MS17-010 EternalBlue) RCE defect.
SMB_ETERNALBLUE_PROBE.pattern: SMB Negotiate Protocol Request specifying SMBv1 NT LM 0.12 followed by tree connect probe

HTTP_SHELLSHOCK_PROBE.name: HTTP Shellshock Probe (CVE-2014-6271)
HTTP_SHELLSHOCK_PROBE.description: Tests web endpoints for bash environment variable injection vulnerability in CGI scripts.

SSH_BRUTE_FORCE.name: SSH Credential Spray / Brute Force
SSH_BRUTE_FORCE.description: Repeated authentication connection attempts to Port 22 within a short window.

RDP_DESKTOP_PROBE.name: RDP Unauthorized Desktop Probe
RDP_DESKTOP_PROBE.description: External unauthenticated desktop endpoint sweep and connection probe.

FTP_BRUTE_FORCE.name: FTP Credential Brute Force
FTP_BRUTE_FORCE.description: Rapid USER and PASS command dictionary probe.

MYSQL_BRUTE_FORCE.name: MySQL Authentication Probe
MYSQL_BRUTE_FORCE.description: High frequency connection attempts targeting database root/admin credentials.

REDIS_UNAUTH_PROBE.name: Redis Unauthorized Command Access
REDIS_UNAUTH_PROBE.description: Unauthenticated access attempting CONFIG SET or rogue replication commands.

SYN_FLOOD.name: TCP SYN Flood (DoS)
SYN_FLOOD.description: Saturates TCP half-open connection queues with high-volume SYN frames.

UDP_FLOOD.name: UDP Packet Flood (DoS)
UDP_FLOOD.description: Floods target port with raw high-volume UDP datagrams.

ICMP_ECHO_FLOOD.name: ICMP Ping Flood (DoS)
ICMP_ECHO_FLOOD.description: Oversized ICMP echo request flood attempting network link saturation.

HTTP_GET_FLOOD.name: Layer-7 HTTP Flood
HTTP_GET_FLOOD.description: High-frequency HTTP requests exhausting application thread pools.

SLOWLORIS_ATTACK.name: Slowloris Connection Exhaustion
SLOWLORIS_ATTACK.description: Keeps hundreds of HTTP connections open with slow incomplete headers.

MAC_SPOOF_ARP_POISON.name: MAC Spoofing / ARP Cache Poisoning
MAC_SPOOF_ARP_POISON.description: Layer-2 hardware address anomaly: IP bound to conflicting MAC address.

REVERSE_SHELL_PROBE.name: Reverse Shell Listener Probe
REVERSE_SHELL_PROBE.description: Inbound connection to known Metasploit/Netcat reverse shell ports (4444, 5555, 9001).

LOG4SHELL_EXPLOIT.name: Log4Shell JNDI Probe (CVE-2021-44228)
LOG4SHELL_EXPLOIT.description: Injects '${jndi:ldap://...}' strings into HTTP headers or parameters.
